product_overview: Nexa Pay public website is a marketing and lead-capture site for a Morocco-focused digital wallet. It explains the product, supports English/French/Arabic browsing, and collects early-access waitlist signups.
core_goals: Learn what Nexa Pay is and how it fits into the broader ecosystem
Browse the public landing page content across its main sections
Switch between English, French, and Arabic content
Toggle between light and dark theme
Submit the waitlist form to request early access
Read the longer SEO explainer pages for Nexa Pay

features.name: Landing page browsing and section navigation
features.description: Users can explore the main marketing landing page, move through its sections, and jump to key content areas from navigation and footer links.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through the hero, value proposition, services, pillars, segments, early access, roadmap, trust, and footer sections -> Observe the full marketing narrative
Navigate to / -> Open footer quick links -> Jump to a referenced section on the landing page -> Continue browsing from that section
Navigate to / -> Choose the About Nexa Pay link from the footer -> Reach the explanatory article page

features.name: Language switching and locale persistence
features.description: Users can change the site language between English, French, and Arabic, with the chosen locale reflected across visible content and page direction.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the language selector -> Choose French -> See the page content update to French
Navigate to / -> Open the language selector -> Choose Arabic -> See the page content update with right-to-left layout
Navigate to / -> Open the language selector -> Choose English -> See the page content return to English

features.name: Theme switching
features.description: Users can switch the site between light and dark appearance modes for comfortable browsing.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle the theme setting -> See the interface switch from light mode to dark mode
Navigate to / -> Toggle the theme setting again -> See the interface switch back to light mode

features.name: Join waitlist submission
features.description: Users can submit their contact details to request early access to Nexa Pay.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in full name -> Fill in phone number -> Fill in email -> Select city -> Select user type -> Optionally describe how they will use Nexa Pay -> Submit the form -> See a success confirmation
Navigate to / -> Fill in full name -> Fill in phone number -> Fill in an invalid email address -> Select city -> Submit the form -> See a validation error message
Navigate to / -> Fill in the required contact details -> Leave out a required field -> Submit the form -> See a validation error message

features.name: Nexa Pay explainer pages
features.description: Users can read long-form informational pages about Nexa Pay in English, French, and Arabic.
user_flows: Navigate to /about/nexa-pay -> Read the English explainer content -> Follow the home link back to the main site
Navigate to /fr/about/nexa-pay -> Read the French explainer content -> Follow the home link back to the main site
Navigate to /ar/about/nexa-pay -> Read the Arabic explainer content -> Observe the right-to-left layout -> Follow the home link back to the main site

Click submit and see success or error message
